name: Mary Meier

events.title: Baptism
events.description: Baptized 4 Sept 1864. Godparents were Magnus Held (20, single day labourer, son of Sebastian Held) and Josepha [Fischer?] (20, single).

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Henry Rose (b. 1861 Essen, d. 19 May 1927). Daughters Anna Francis, Josephine, Agatha Mary (who married George T. Duffin in 1917) and Mae Mercedes.

events.title: Named as mother in daughter Josephine Rose Flynn's 1920 marriage
events.description: Luzerne docket No. 91450: Josephine Flynn, 31, born Hazleton, widow (her first husband died 24 Dec 1918), married Charles P. Preso. Her father is given as Henry Rose and her mother as Mary, maiden name Meyers, both born in Germany.

bioAdditions: Mary was born at Munzingen on 3 Sept 1864 at four in the afternoon and baptized the next day as 'Maria Mayer, legitimate daughter of the local citizen and mason Friedrich Mayer and Marianna Birkenmaier, both Catholic' (S1). She is indexed as 'Mayer Maria d. Friedrich, p. 526'. This corrects the tree's birth year of 1865, and the 1865 Munzingen birth index has no Mayer child of Friedrich. The FamilySearch tree has her marriage to Henry Rose in 1885, four daughters, and her death at Hazleton on 9 Dec 1938 (S2).
openQuestionsNew: PA death index 1938 (Rose, Mary, Hazleton, Dec 1938) for the certificate number.
